title: Step 2: Walk Around
story: Now the hero can look. Next, the hero must be able to walk.
goal: Add move(room, direction): return the room you reach, or the same room if there is no exit that way.
hints: The exits dictionary maps a direction to a room.
.get(direction, room) returns the current room when the exit is missing.
socratic: What should walking into a wall do?
Which function do the earlier checks still need?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: how does this checkpoint build on the last one?
